paper.title: Bernoulli Rank-$1$ Bandits for Click Feedback

unmapped: Actions are (row, column) pairs in [K] x [L_col]; reward is the product u_t(i) v_t(j) of independent Bernoulli row and column rewards, so the mean reward matrix is rank 1 (position-based click model)
The learner knows the number of columns L_col
settings.definition_quote: An instance of our learning problem is a tuple $B = (K, L, P_\textsc{u}, P_\textsc{v})$, where $K$ is the number of rows, $L$ is the number of columns, $P_{\textsc{u}}$ is a distribution over $\set{0, 1}^K$ from which the row rewards are drawn, and $P_{\textsc{v}}$ is a distribution over $\set{0, 1}^L$ from which the column rewards are drawn. ... At time $t$, the learning agent chooses a row index $\rnd{i}_t \in [K]$ and a column index $\rnd{j}_t \in [L]$, and observes $\rnd{u}_t(\rnd{i}_t) \rnd{v}(\rnd{j}_t)$ as its reward.

symbols.mu_avg: min of the average row mean and average column mean, min{(1/K) sum_i ubar(i), (1/L) sum_j vbar(j)}
symbols.gamma: max{mu_avg, 1 - p_max}, p_max the largest row/column mean
symbols.sum_rows_inv_gap: sum over rows i of 1/Delta_bar^U_i, where Delta_bar^U_i = Delta^U_i, or Delta^V_min if Delta^U_i = 0
symbols.sum_cols_inv_gap: sum over columns j of 1/Delta_bar^V_j, where Delta_bar^V_j = Delta^V_j, or Delta^U_min if Delta^V_j = 0

conditions: row and column rewards Bernoulli, independent of each other
tuning: delta_l = log n + 3 log log n

source.label: thm:upper bound
source.quote: Let $C = 6 e + 82$, $n\ge 5$. The expected $n$-step regret of $\rklucb$ is bounded as R(n) \leq \frac{160}{\mu \gamma} \left(\sum_{i = 1}^K \frac{1}{\bar{\Delta}^\textsc{u}_i} + \sum_{j = 1}^L \frac{1}{\bar{\Delta}^\textsc{v}_j}\right) \log n + C(K + L), where \bar{\Delta}^\textsc{u}_i = \Delta^\textsc{u}_i + \I{\Delta^\textsc{u}_i = 0} \Delta^\textsc{v}_{\min}, ...

results.notes: Regret is defined as E[sum_t u_t(i*)v_t(j*) - u_t(i_t)v_t(j_t)] with fixed (i*,j*), so it equals pseudo-regret. The algorithm uses log n, so the horizon is known.

cited_results.setting_description: Stochastic rank-1 bandit with K rows and L columns; mu = min of average row/column means, Delta = min of row and column gaps
